interface.longDescription:
Turn a Spanish public tender into a traceable opportunity brief and a clause-by-clause qualification checklist.

Includes a focused assistant workflow, official-source references, review examples and a Python 3.11+ read-only adapter. In ChatGPT, uses available native browsing/file tools; in Claude Code or Codex, the bundled scripts can retrieve official data directly when networking is permitted. No separate account, API key or publisher-hosted server is required for this skills release.

No exhaustive historical procurement index, private portal automation, digital signatures, bid submission, legal opinions or unattended monitoring. The parser returns document URLs; the host must read the actual documents before qualification.

Independent software by Sami Halawa. Not affiliated with Spanish public authorities.
defaultPrompt: Find recent Spanish software tenders and show exactly what was searched.
Review these tender documents and quote the clauses that determine eligibility.
